description: Switch a user's access channels in THIS tenant (admins only): access_web (app login), access_mcp (API keys and MCP clients such as the claude.ai connector), access_whatsapp (talking to the agent over WhatsApp), and/or phone (the WhatsApp number that identifies them, with country code; null or "" removes it). Required: user_id plus at least one of these.

access_mcp.description: Allow API keys and MCP clients

access_whatsapp.description: Allow talking to the agent via WhatsApp

name: set_user_access
